118370.name: Chabad Jewish Center
118370.note: Its own 2025 Charidy campaign page (in Firecrawl's search index, Nov 10 2026): 'Since the year 2000, the Chabad Jewish Center has stood on the front lines of Jewish life'. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Mendel Krinsky.

1681669.name: Chabad of Downtown Boston
1681669.note: Its own pages (in Firecrawl's search index, Nov 10 2026): 'In 2011, Rabbi Yosef and Shayndel Zaklos were appointed to lead Chabad of Downtown Boston'; 'Since 2011, Rabbi Zaklos serves as the director of Chabad of Downtown Boston'. Medium: the year its directors were appointed; the chabad.org listing went up in 2011 too. Its chabad.org listing went up 2011-11-17, so it existed by then. Director: Yosef Zaklos.

707116.name: Chabad of Pittsford
707116.note: Its own home page (in Firecrawl's search index, Nov 10 2026): 'Founded in 2008 to further Chabad of Rochester...'; the Minority Reporter (on its 18th-anniversary celebration): 'Founded in 2008, Chabad of Pittsford has developed programs for children, teenagers, adults and families'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2008-07-29, so it existed by then. Director: Yitzi Hein.
